collection-time.description: Date and time the results were collected.

msm-id.description: RIPE Atlas measurement ID the results belong to.

observed-ip.description: IP address of the target as seen by the probes (dst_addr in the results). Multiple when probes resolve the name to different addresses. Not an IDS indicator by default: it records what the probes reached, which may be shared infrastructure such as a CDN.

probes-reached-target.description: Number of probes that reached the target (ping: at least one reply; traceroute: destination responded; dns: a response was received; sslcert: a certificate was retrieved).

probes-scheduled.description: Number of probes scheduled for the measurement, as reported by the RIPE Atlas API.

raw-results.description: Raw RIPE Atlas results (JSON) as returned by the API, kept as evidence.

results-received.description: Number of probe results received at collection time.

rtt-max.description: Highest RTT in milliseconds across all probes (maximum of the per-probe maximums).

rtt-median.description: Median in milliseconds of the per-probe median RTTs.

rtt-min.description: Lowest RTT in milliseconds across all probes (minimum of the per-probe minimums).

status.description: Measurement status reported by the RIPE Atlas API at collection time.

description: Results of one collection of a RIPE Atlas measurement. A new object is created on every collection, referencing the ripe-atlas-measurement it was derived from.
name: ripe-atlas-result
